info.title: OpenRails
info.description: OpenRails' HTTP API, from the API root: a standalone server serves it at /, an embedded host beneath its mount (usually /billing). Generated from the route catalog (internal/http/routes) by `go run ./scripts/contracts -write`; do not edit.

estimated_amount.description: A number as a decimal string.

amount.description: A non-negative plain decimal followed by its required registered currency. Uses the currency's native precision exactly, without rounding or currency conversion. Cannot be combined with unit_amount or currency.

oneOf.description: A positive whole number of hours, days, or weeks; for example, 72 hours or 3 days. Normalized to access_duration_hours. Calendar months and years are not supported.
A positive whole number of hours, days, or weeks; for example, 72 hours or 3 days. Normalized to billing_interval_hours. Calendar months and years are not supported.
A positive whole number of hours, days, or weeks; for example, 72 hours or 3 days. Normalized to trial_duration_hours. Calendar months and years are not supported.

ApplyPrice.description: Omitted fields preserve existing terms on updates. amount supplies both unit_amount and currency and cannot be null. Null clears a duration. Each readable duration and its numeric hours alias are mutually exclusive.

Error.description: code is stable and listed in x-openrails-error-codes; type and status follow from it; message is diagnostic and not contract.
A refusal: a code of the operation's x-openrails-errors or of an x-openrails-error-sets set it names.

bearer.description: An API key, a service or delegated token, or a user session token.

access_token_invalid.meaning: The access token is invalid, expired or not issued for this deployment.

access_token_issuer_unknown.meaning: The access token's issuer is not trusted by this deployment.

access_token_merchant_not_bound.meaning: The access token's issuer is not trusted for this merchant.

admission_captured.meaning: The admission was captured; it can no longer be released.

admission_not_found.meaning: No admission was made under this request id.

allowance_meter_not_found.meaning: The rate card's allowance meter does not exist.

allowance_source_in_use.meaning: The allowance source is in use.

allowance_source_invalid.meaning: The allowance source cannot back this rate card.

api_host_taken.meaning: The api_host is assigned to another merchant.

api_host_unproven.meaning: The api_host's DNS proof was not found.

as_of_required.meaning: The import needs as_of, its RFC 3339 evidence horizon.

authentication_unavailable.meaning: The credential could not be verified right now; retry.

authorization_unavailable.meaning: Permissions could not be checked right now; retry.

billing_archive_integrity.meaning: The billing archive failed integrity validation.

billing_archive_invalid_artifact.meaning: The billing archive is invalid, incomplete or unsupported.

billing_archive_merchant_mismatch.meaning: The archive's merchant is not the destination's.

billing_archive_not_empty.meaning: The destination's billing state must be empty.

billing_archive_unsupported_state.meaning: The merchant has state that cannot safely be moved.

billing_policy_not_found.meaning: The billing policy does not exist.

cancel_unsupported_on_rail.meaning: This rail has no cancel operation.

captcha_required.meaning: The caller must solve a captcha and resend with its token.

card_attempts_blocked.meaning: Too many declined card attempts; try again later.

card_declined.meaning: The provider declined the card; metadata.decline_reason says why.

card_not_saved.meaning: The card was not saved; enter it again.

card_requires_https.meaning: Card data is accepted only over HTTPS.

catalog_revision_conflict.meaning: The catalog changed during the application; retry.

catalog_updates_disabled.meaning: Catalog updates over HTTP are disabled in this deployment.

checkout_attempt_closed.meaning: The checkout attempt already completed or was canceled.

checkout_attempt_expired.meaning: The checkout attempt expired before it was paid.

checkout_payment_in_progress.meaning: A payment on this checkout session is already being processed.

checkout_session_not_found.meaning: The checkout session does not exist.

checkout_session_unavailable.meaning: The checkout session is not available to this caller.

collection_payment_method_invalid.meaning: The collection payment method cannot pay this invoice.

collection_payment_method_required.meaning: Collection needs a payment method for the invoice's currency.

credential_custody_transition_required.meaning: Credential custody differs from the published backend.

credential_identity_mismatch.meaning: The credential changed identity during the request.

credential_operation_conflict.meaning: The credential operation conflicts with the published revision.

credential_revoked.meaning: The credential or its session was revoked.

credential_source_read_only.meaning: The provider credential source has no writable custody.

credentials_manage_required.meaning: The account lacks credential-management authority on this merchant.

credit_grant_held.meaning: Active holds need the grant's remaining credit.

credit_grant_not_found.meaning: The credit grant does not exist.

credit_grant_unavailable.meaning: The credit grant expired, ended or has no remaining credit.

csrf_origin_denied.meaning: A cookie-authenticated request came from an origin that is not allowed.

currency_unsupported.meaning: The currency is not in OpenRails' registry.

custodian_capture_unavailable.meaning: The card custodian cannot capture cards right now.

customer_action_required.meaning: Only the customer may take this action, through their own step.

customer_email_required.meaning: The rail needs the customer's verified email and username.

customer_payment_unsupported.meaning: Customer-present payment is unsupported for this rail or method.

customer_session_required.meaning: The operation needs the customer's interactive session.

dashboard_invalid.meaning: The dashboard is invalid; metadata.errors lists why.

database_busy.meaning: No database connection is available; retry shortly.

default_rate_card_not_found.meaning: The meter has no default rate card.

default_rate_card_required.meaning: The meter needs a default rate card.

delegated_principal_invalid.meaning: The host's delegated principal names no usable merchant or subject.

email_unverified.meaning: The operation needs a verified email.

finding_action_failed.meaning: Running the finding's recommendation failed; the finding stays open with the error in its notes.

finding_not_actionable.meaning: The finding carries no recommendation to approve; ignore it or fix it out of band.

hold_not_found.meaning: The admission holds nothing open: it was captured, released or lapsed.

host_event_not_found.meaning: The host event does not exist.

host_merchant_mismatch.meaning: The credential's merchant is not the one this host serves.

host_principal_invalid.meaning: The in-process host principal is bound to no merchant.

idempotency_key_required.meaning: The operation needs an Idempotency-Key header.

idempotency_key_reused.meaning: The idempotency key already committed with different terms.

insufficient_credits.meaning: The customer's credit balance does not cover the operation.

insufficient_scope.meaning: The access token was not granted the scope this surface requires.

internal_error.meaning: OpenRails failed; request_id identifies the failure in its logs.

invalid_api_host.meaning: api_host must be a bare lowercase domain name.

invalid_cursor.meaning: The cursor is not one this list issued.

invalid_customer_id.meaning: The customer id is missing or malformed.

invalid_email.meaning: The email is missing or malformed.

invalid_host_event_request.meaning: The host event request is invalid.

invalid_name.meaning: The name is missing or too long.

invalid_param.meaning: The request is malformed or a parameter is invalid; param names the parameter when known.

invalid_payment_method.meaning: The payment method is not eligible for this operation.

invalid_query.meaning: A query parameter is malformed or out of range; param is the parameter.

invalid_request_body.meaning: The request body could not be read or is not one JSON value.

invalid_settlement_status_request.meaning: A settlement status read needs a customer and a price.

invalid_user.meaning: The user id is missing or malformed.

invites_disabled.meaning: The email has no verified account and invitations by registration are disabled.

invoice_action_not_allowed.meaning: The invoice's status does not allow this action.

invoice_not_retryable.meaning: The invoice cannot be collected again.

invoice_payment_exceeds_due.meaning: The recorded payment exceeds the amount due.

invoice_payment_reference_used.meaning: The payment reference is already recorded.

invoice_retry_idempotency_conflict.meaning: The idempotency key names a different collection attempt.

invoice_retry_in_progress.meaning: A collection attempt on this invoice is unresolved.

invoice_retry_outcome_unknown.meaning: The last collection attempt's outcome is unknown.

invoker_scoped_principal.meaning: An invoker-scoped credential spends a customer's balance but may not manage the account.

last_owner.meaning: A merchant must keep at least one owner.

members_manage_required.meaning: The account lacks team-management authority on this merchant.

merchant_binding_mismatch.meaning: The selected merchant is not the one the credential, deployment or request is bound to.

merchant_configuration_application_confl.meaning: The application id already committed with different content.

merchant_configuration_revision_conflict.meaning: The merchant configuration changed; read its revision before applying.

merchant_context_mismatch.meaning: The authorized merchant is not the one the request resolved.

merchant_creation_payment_method_require.meaning: Creating another merchant needs a payment method on file.

merchant_directory_unavailable.meaning: The merchant directory could not be read; retry.

merchant_not_found.meaning: No active merchant answers to the selector.

merchant_selector_invalid.meaning: The OpenRails-Merchant header is malformed, repeated or names no merchant.

merchant_unresolved.meaning: The credential names no merchant, or more than one; select one.

meter_in_use.meaning: The meter is referenced and cannot change this way.

meter_rate_card_conflict.meaning: The meter and its rate card disagree.

method_not_allowed.meaning: The path exists but not for this method; Allow lists its methods.

metrics_query_invalid.meaning: The metrics query is invalid; metadata.errors lists why.

model_unavailable.meaning: The language model did not answer; retry, or ask a narrower question.

operation_authorization_conflict.meaning: The operation id was reused with a changed term; param names it.

operation_authorization_has_billing_evid.meaning: The operation authorization already carries provider billing evidence.

operation_authorization_not_found.meaning: The operation authorization does not exist.

operation_authorization_not_open.meaning: The operation authorization is no longer open.

payment_duplicate_refused.meaning: The provider refused an identical charge it had just made; retry after its duplicate window.

payment_idempotency_conflict.meaning: The idempotency key belongs to another payment request.

payment_in_progress.meaning: A payment is already unresolved; read the resource before retrying.

payment_method_delete_failed.meaning: The provider could not delete the payment method.

payment_method_delete_unsupported.meaning: This payment method cannot be deleted through OpenRails.

payment_method_not_psp_vaulted.meaning: The payment method is not held in the provider vault.

payment_method_not_usable.meaning: The payment method cannot be charged in its current state.

payment_method_psp_mismatch.meaning: The payment method is vaulted by another PSP than the subscription's.

payment_method_required.meaning: The charge names neither a saved payment method nor a new card token.

payment_method_same_vault.meaning: The card is in the provider vault the subscription already bills.

payment_method_stale.meaning: The saved payment method can no longer be charged; collect the card again.

payment_method_update_failed.meaning: The provider could not update the payment method.

payment_method_update_retry_required.meaning: The card was not updated; tokenize it again.

payment_method_update_unsupported.meaning: This payment method cannot be updated through OpenRails.

payment_not_found.meaning: The payment or payment operation does not exist.

payment_not_refundable.meaning: The payment is not a completed rail charge, or the amount exceeds what remains refundable.

payment_not_retryable.meaning: The resource is not payable now.

payment_provider_rejected.meaning: The provider refused to process the charge for a gateway or account reason.

permanent_grant_forbidden.meaning: A grant with no end needs merchant:access:grant-permanent.

permission_required.meaning: The credential lacks the permission the route requires.

price_key_cadence_conflict.meaning: The product's default price key is held by a price on another cadence.

price_not_sellable.meaning: No PSP can sell this price.

product_tier_group_conflict.meaning: A customer holds live subscriptions to more than one product of the tier group.

product_tier_group_in_use.meaning: The tier group cannot change while a subscription has a plan change in flight.

provider_billing_observation_conflict.meaning: The provider billing evidence conflicts with a recorded observation; param names it.

provider_billing_qualification_not_found.meaning: The operation has no provider billing qualification.

provider_billing_qualification_refused.meaning: The provider billing evidence was refused.

provider_cancel_held.meaning: Cancelling needs a destructive provider action that is not armed for this merchant.

provider_outcome_unknown.meaning: The provider did not confirm the outcome; read the resource before retrying.

psp_claim_requires_proof.meaning: Claiming a provider account needs credentials that prove control of it.

psp_exists.meaning: The account is already a PSP, of this merchant or another; update it instead.

psp_key_taken.meaning: Another live PSP holds the key.

psp_last_active.meaning: The PSP is the last active one on its rail; pass allow_last to archive it.

purchase_review_resolved.meaning: The purchase review was already resolved.

rate_card_currency_mismatch.meaning: The rate card's currency does not match.

rate_card_has_overrides.meaning: The rate card still has customer overrides.

rate_card_product_not_found.meaning: The rate card names a product that does not exist.

rate_limit_exceeded.meaning: Too many requests; Retry-After says when to try again.

rebill_terms_committed.meaning: An accepted recurring payment owns the pending price terms.

refund_rail_unavailable.meaning: The payment's rail cannot accept a refund right now.

refund_unsupported.meaning: The payment's rail has no automatic refund.

rename_too_soon.meaning: The merchant was renamed too recently.

reprice_already_scheduled.meaning: The subscription already has a scheduled reprice.

reprice_cross_currency.meaning: The target price must be in the same currency.

reprice_cross_product.meaning: The target price must be on the same product.

reprice_inactive_price.meaning: The target price must be active.

reprice_not_scheduled.meaning: The reprice is no longer scheduled.

reprice_notice_window_violation.meaning: effective_at is inside the merchant's notice window for a price increase.

reprice_price_key_not_found.meaning: The reprice names a price key that does not exist.

reprice_target_price_not_found.meaning: The reprice's target price does not exist.

request_body_too_large.meaning: The request body exceeds the deployment's cap.

resource_access_denied.meaning: The credential may not access this resource.

resource_conflict.meaning: The request conflicts with the resource's current state.

resource_not_found.meaning: The addressed resource does not exist in this merchant.

role_escalation.meaning: The grant exceeds the caller's own authority.

sender_proof_required.meaning: A sender-constrained token arrived without its DPoP proof.

service_credential_customer_scope_denied.meaning: The service credential may not act for this customer.

service_credential_invalid.meaning: The API key or service token is invalid.

service_credential_merchant_unresolved.meaning: The service credential's issuer owns no merchant.

service_credential_resource_scope_denied.meaning: The service credential is scoped to other resources.

service_unavailable.meaning: A dependency is temporarily unavailable; retry.

solana_rpc_unavailable.meaning: The Solana RPC endpoints did not answer; retry.

solana_transaction_refused.meaning: The wallet transaction could not be prepared or confirmed; the message says why.

spend_delegation_not_found.meaning: The spend delegation does not exist.

step_up_required.meaning: The operation needs a recent sign-in; metadata carries the challenge.

step_up_unavailable.meaning: The operation needs a recent sign-in and this credential cannot prove one.

tier_change_already_scheduled.meaning: A different period-end change is already scheduled.

tier_change_cadence_unsupported.meaning: A provider-billed subscription can change only to a price of the same cadence.

tier_change_credit_exceeds_price.meaning: The current plan's unused value exceeds the target price; change at period end.

tier_change_cycle_unknown.meaning: The target price has no positive billing cycle.

tier_change_idempotency_conflict.meaning: The Idempotency-Key already names a different tier change.

tier_change_idempotency_key_required.meaning: A tier change needs an Idempotency-Key.

tier_change_in_flight.meaning: Another unresolved tier change owns the subscription; metadata.operation_id names it.

tier_change_period_unknown.meaning: The subscription has no valid current period.

tier_change_provider_conflict.meaning: The provider's copy of the subscription is missing or differs; reconcile it first.

tier_change_refused.meaning: The tier change was refused and not executed.

tier_change_renewal_due.meaning: The current period ended or its renewal is unresolved; the renewal settles first.

tier_change_requires_linked_plan.meaning: The target price has no plan on the subscription's PSP that this change can use.

tier_change_target_inactive.meaning: The target price or its product is archived.

tier_change_unsupported_on_rail.meaning: The subscription's rail cannot make this tier change.

trial_unsupported_on_rail.meaning: This rail cannot run a trial first phase.

unknown_field.meaning: The JSON body names a field the route does not accept; param is the field.

unknown_role.meaning: The role is not one this merchant defines.

unsupported_media_type.meaning: The request body is not application/json.

usage_meter_not_found.meaning: The usage meter does not exist.

usage_rate_card_invalid.meaning: The usage rate card is invalid.

use_dpop_nonce.meaning: The DPoP proof must carry the server nonce; retry with the DPoP-Nonce header's value.

webhook_account_mismatch.meaning: The webhook's account does not match its payload.

widget_generation_invalid.meaning: The model could not produce a valid query for the prompt.
